name: Signal Sifter — Auto (Demo page + real Google Alerts pipeline)

nodes.name: Demo Webhook (from page)
nodes.notes: This is the URL the demo page calls. After activating, copy its Production URL into signal-sifter-auto.html's RELAY_URL constant.

nodes.name: Read Google Alerts RSS
nodes.notes: Set up a Google Alert for your keyword, choose 'RSS feed' as delivery, and paste that feed URL here.

nodes.name: Skip Already-Seen Items
nodes.notes: Stops the same RSS item from being re-checked (and re-posted to Slack) every time the schedule runs. If this node errors or looks different after import, n8n changed its shape a bit across versions — just reconfigure it to compare on the 'link' field, or tell me and I'll swap in a Google-Sheet-based dedupe instead.

nodes.name: Prepare Items
nodes.notes: One node, two jobs: turns whatever the demo page sent into a clean list of mentions, OR (if it ran off the RSS branch) turns RSS entries into the same shape. Edit the TOPIC/CONTEXT/API_KEY lines in the 'Branch B' section for the unattended production path.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Needs your own Slack credential connected (Credentials > New > Slack, a few clicks + one Slack authorize popup). Change #signal-sifter-demo to your real channel.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { results: $input.all().map(item => ({ text: item.json.text, prob: item.json.prob })) } }];

nodes.name: Respond to Page
nodes.notes: Only matters when a schedule run reaches here it just quietly does nothing (no webhook is waiting) — that's expected and harmless.

parameters.content:
## What this workflow does
Two entry points feed the SAME checking + Slack logic:

1. **Demo Webhook** — the page's "Run Demo Batch" button posts here with a visitor's own key + mentions. Results come back to the page AND real ones get posted to Slack.
2. **Every 6 Hours** — reads your real Google Alerts RSS feed, checks each new item, posts real ones to Slack. This is the actually-unattended part.

## Setup, in order
1. Import this file into n8n.
2. Open 'Prepare Items', scroll to the 'Branch B' section, fill in TOPIC / CONTEXT / your real Jev API key (this one runs with no visitor, so it needs a real stored key here).
3. Open 'Read Google Alerts RSS' — go create a Google Alert for your term, choose 'RSS feed' delivery, paste that feed URL in.
4. Open 'Post to Slack' — connect your Slack credential, set the channel.
5. Turn Settings > 'Save manual executions' OFF (same reason as the relay workflow — don't want visitor keys sitting in execution logs).
6. Activate the workflow.
7. Copy 'Demo Webhook (from page)' node's Production URL into signal-sifter-auto.html's RELAY_URL.

The demo webhook path needs no Slack/RSS setup to work for testing — only the schedule path (real production alerting) needs steps 2-4.
